font_families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

layouts.modal_backdrop: fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-6 lg:p-10 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md transition-opacity duration-300

modal_tier_matrix.tier_sm: max-w-md w-full rounded-[28px] overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[85vh]
modal_tier_matrix.tier_md: max-w-xl w-full rounded-[28px] overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[85vh]
modal_tier_matrix.tier_lg: max-w-3xl w-full rounded-[28px] overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[90vh]
modal_tier_matrix.tier_xl_2pane: max-w-5xl w-full rounded-[28px] overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[90vh]
modal_tier_matrix.tier_fullscreen: w-full h-full rounded-none lg:rounded-[28px] lg:max-w-[1600px] lg:h-[92vh]

two_pane_modals: Custom Studio Upload Form (Left: Cover Art upload & audio stem preview, Right: Song Metadata fields & tagger)
Edit Track / Music Manager (Left: Track selection & cover art, Right: Detailed track attributes, stems & lyric finder)
Zodiac / Numerology / Fortune Hub (Left: Hero Sign Orb, daily fortune & moon phase, Right: 4-tab card deck for Lucky numbers/colors/match)
Settings Sub-modals (Left: Category navigation rail, Right: Active settings panel)

lyric_studio_3_column_spec.breakpoint: lg:grid lg:grid-cols-[300px_1fr_340px] xl:grid-cols-[340px_1fr_380px] lg:gap-6 lg:h-full lg:p-6

left_rail.title: Toolbox & Song Meta
components: Audio Track Card (wavesurfer preview, play/pause, timecode)
Writing Assistant & Rhyme Helper Quick Toggles
Document Statistics (Word count, line count, syllabic rhythm meter)
left_rail.styling: bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-5 overflow-y-auto space-y-5

center_editor.title: Paper Editor Panel
components: Format Toolbar (Bold, Italic, Ad-lib, Quote, UPPER, lower, Repeat x2, Pause, Hold)
Paper Textarea + Live Syntax Overlay (Section tags, bold purple, italic gold, ad-lib cyan)
center_editor.styling: bg-[var(--paper-editor-bg)] border border-[var(--paper-border)] rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-2xl flex flex-col h-full

right_preview.title: Live Player Preview Rail
components: Mini Now Playing Deck (Album art, Track title, Sync progress)
Karaoke Live Line Scroll (Highlight active singing line with glowing purple/gold text, blurred inactive lines)
Device Screen Scale Toggle (Mobile View / Stage View)
right_preview.styling: bg-black/40 border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-5 flex flex-col justify-between

header_pattern.layout: sticky top-0 z-20 flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-4 border-b border-white/10 bg-[rgba(20,16,32,0.92)] backdrop-blur-md
header_pattern.elements: Left: Eyebrow kicker (uppercase 10px mono) + Title ('Special Gothic Expanded One'). Right: Action buttons + Close icon button (36px rounded-full hover:bg-white/10)

body_pattern.layout: p-6 lg:p-8 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar flex-1 space-y-6

footer_pattern.layout: sticky bottom-0 z-20 flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-4 border-t border-white/10 bg-[rgba(20,16,32,0.92)] backdrop-blur-md
footer_pattern.elements: Left: Secondary metadata/status. Right: Primary action pill buttons with purple glow

motion.modal_entrance: transition-all duration-300 ease-out transform scale-95 opacity-0 state-open:scale-100 state-open:opacity-100

accessibility.test_id_convention: All interactive elements, inputs, modal triggers, and action buttons MUST include data-testid (e.g. data-testid='lyric-studio-save-button')
accessibility.contrast_ratio: Minimum 4.5:1 WCAG AA contrast for text overlays; non-transparent modal backgrounds

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply desktop ≥1024px styles without breaking mobile sheet layouts (<1024px).
Ensure ALL modal headers are sticky with solid/glass background (NEVER transparent).
Convert Lyric Studio into a 3-column desktop layout using CSS grid when viewport is ≥1024px.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do NOT center align the app container globally.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, headers, or overlays.
Ensure proper data-testid attributes on all buttons, inputs, tabs, and modals.
Ensure smooth hover states and optical padding inside bordered containers.
